sn55.21:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sakkesu viharati kapilavatthusmiṃ nigrodhārāme.
sn55.21:1.3: atha kho mahānāmo sakko yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkami upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdi. ekamantaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
sn55.21:1.4: idaṃ bhante kapilavatthu iddhañceva phītañca bahujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhaviyūhaṃ.
sn55.21:1.5: so khvāhaṃ bhante bhagavantaṃ vā payirupāsitvā manobhāvanīye vā bhikkhū sāyaṇhasamayaṃ kapilavatthuṃ pavisanto
sn55.21:1.11: tassa mayhaṃ bhante tasmiṃ samaye mussateva bhagavantaṃ ārabbha sati mussati dhammaṃ ārabbha sati mussati saṅghaṃ ārabbha sati.
sn55.21:1.13: imamhi cāhaṃ samaye kālaṃ kareyyaṃ kā mayhaṃ gati ko abhisamparāyoti.
sn55.21:2.1: mā bhāyi mahānāma mā bhāyi mahānāma
sn55.21:2.3: yassa kassaci mahānāma dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīlaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sutaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ cāgaparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ. tassa yo hi khvāyaṃ kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsupacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo
sn55.21:2.4: taṃ imeva kākā vā khādanti gijjhā vā khādanti kulalā vā khādanti sunakhā vā khādanti sigālā vā khādanti vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti.
sn55.21:2.5: yañca khvassa cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ sīla suta cāga paññāparibhāvitaṃ taṃ uddhaṅgāmi hoti visesagāmi.
sn55.21:3.1: seyyathāpi mahānāma puriso sappikumbhaṃ vā telakumbhaṃ vā gambhīraṃ udakarahadaṃ ogāhetvā bhindeyya
sn55.21:3.2: tatra yā assa sakkharā vā kaṭhalā vā sā adhogāmī assa yañca khvassa tatra sappi vā telaṃ vā taṃ uddhaṅgāmi assa visesagāmi.
sn55.21:3.3: evameva kho mahānāma yassa kassaci dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīla suta cāga
sn55.21:3.4: paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ tassa yo hi khvāyaṃ kāyo rūpī cātummahābhūtiko mātāpettikasambhavo odanakummāsupacayo aniccucchādanaparimaddanabhedanaviddhaṃsanadhammo taṃ imeva kākā vā khādanti gijjhā vā khādanti kulalā vā khādanti sunakhā vā khādanti sigālā vā khādanti vividhā vā pāṇakajātā khādanti
sn55.21:3.5: yañca khvassa cittaṃ dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ sīla suta cāga paññāparibhāvitaṃ taṃ uddhaṅgāmi hoti visesagāmi.
sn55.21:3.6: tuyhaṃ kho pana mahānāma dīgharattaṃ saddhāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ sīla suta cāga paññāparibhāvitaṃ cittaṃ.
sn55.21:3.7: mā bhāyi mahānāma mā bhāyi mahānāma
